```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(lubridate)


df <- read.csv("Cleanedcal_ads_df.csv")

df$Ad_Date <- as.character(df$Ad_Date)

df$Ad_Date <- case_when(
  nchar(df$Ad_Date) == 8 & substr(df$Ad_Date,1,4) == "2024" ~ 
    ymd(df$Ad_Date),
  TRUE ~ 
    dmy(df$Ad_Date)
)

```



```{r roas_plot, echo=FALSE}

output$roas_plot <- renderPlotly({ 
  
  req(input$Keyword, input$metric)
  
  
   summary_data <- df %>%
    filter(Keyword == input$Keyword) %>%
    group_by(Ad_ID) %>%
    summarise(
      total_sales = sum(Sale_Amount, na.rm = TRUE),
      metric_value = mean(.data[[input$metric]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_sales)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) 
  
  p <- ggplot(summary_data,
         aes(x = reorder(Ad_ID,metric_value), y = metric_value)) +
    geom_col(fill = "navy") + 
    theme_minimal() + 
    labs(title = paste(input$metric, "Top 10 Ads by Sales(",input$metric,")"),
         x = "Ad ID", y = input$metric)
  
  ggplotly(p)
  })  
```

```{r spendscatter, echo=FALSE}

output$spend_vs_sales <- renderPlotly({

  summary_data <- df %>%
    group_by(Keyword) %>%
    summarise(
      total_spend = sum(Cost, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_sales = sum(Sale_Amount, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  k <- ggplot(summary_data,
              aes(x = total_spend,
                  y = total_sales,
                  text = Keyword)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, color = "blue") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Spend vs Sales by Keyword",
         x = "Total Spend",
         y = "Total Sales")

  ggplotly(k, tooltip = "text")
})
```

```{r roas_static, echo = FALSE}


output$roas_static <- renderPlotly({

  summary_data <- df %>%
    group_by(Keyword) %>%
    summarise(avg_roas = mean(ROAS, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_roas))

 q <- ggplot(summary_data,
         aes(x = reorder(Keyword, avg_roas),
             y = avg_roas)) +
    geom_col(fill = "darkgreen") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Average ROAS by Keyword",
         x = "Keyword",
         y = "Average ROAS")
 
 ggplotly(q)
})

```


```{r growthtrend, echo = FALSE}


output$growth_kpi <- renderUI({
  
  summary_data <- df %>%
    mutate(Month = format(Ad_Date, "%Y-%m")) %>%
    group_by(Month) %>%
    summarise(total_sales = sum(Sale_Amount, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(Month)
  
  if (nrow(summary_data) < 2) {
    return(HTML("<h3>Not enough data for growth</h3>"))
  }
  
  growth_pct <- (tail(summary_data$total_sales, 1) /
                 head(tail(summary_data$total_sales, 2), 1) - 1) * 100
  
  color <- ifelse(growth_pct >= 0, "green", "red")
  arrow <- ifelse(growth_pct >= 0, "▲", "▼")
  
  HTML(paste0(
    "<div style='text-align:center;'>",
    "<h1 style='color:", color, ";'>",
    arrow, " ", round(growth_pct, 2), "%</h1>",
    "<p>Month-over-Month Growth</p>",
    "</div>"
  ))
})


```

```{r roasbox, echo = FALSE}


output$roas_box <- renderPlotly({
  
  b <- ggplot(df,
              aes(x = Keyword,
                  y = ROAS)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "orange") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "ROAS Distribution by Keyword",
         x = "Keyword",
         y = "ROAS")
  
  ggplotly(b)
})
```

```{r KPI_box, echo = FALSE}

output$kpi_boxes <- renderUI({

  total_spend <- sum(df$Cost, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_sales <- sum(df$Sale_Amount, na.rm = TRUE)
  avg_roas <- mean(df$ROAS, na.rm = TRUE)

  HTML(paste0(
    "<div style='display:flex; justify-content:space-around;'>",
    "<div><h3>Total Cost</h3><h2>", scales::comma(round(total_spend,0)), "</h2></div>",
    "<div><h3>Total Sales</h3><h2>", scales::comma(round(total_sales,0)), "</h2></div>",
    "<div><h3>Avg ROAS</h3><h2>", round(avg_roas,2), "</h2></div>",
    "</div>"
  ))
})
```


```{r layout, echo=FALSE}

br()

h2("Overall KPI's")
# --- KPI Row ---
fluidRow(
  column(12,
         uiOutput("kpi_boxes")
  )
)

br()

# --- Growth KPI ---
h2("Month-over-Month Growth")


fluidRow(
  column(12,
         uiOutput("growth_kpi")
  )
)

br()

# --- Performance Overview ---
h2("Performance Overview")


fluidRow(
  column(6,
         plotlyOutput("roas_static")
  ),
  column(6,
         plotlyOutput("spend_vs_sales")
  )
)

br()

# --- Ad Level Deep Dive ---
h2("Ad-Level Deep Dive")


fluidRow(
  column(12,
         
         inputPanel( 
  selectInput("Keyword",
              "Choose Keyword:",
              choices = unique(df$Keyword)),

  selectInput("metric",
              "Choose Metric:",
              choices = c("ROAS","CTR","Conversion.Rate"))
)))

br()

fluidRow(
  column(12,

         plotlyOutput("roas_plot")
  )
)

br()


# --- Distribution Analysis ---

h2("ROAS Distribution Analysis")

fluidRow(
  column(12,
         plotlyOutput("roas_box")
  )
)

```
